fails.question: How do I send a campaign to Central-only members from Command Centre?
fails.answer_verbatim:
16:11
🤖

Command Centre can prepare the campaign draft, but it does not directly send a bulk campaign. For Bluebird Central-only members, open Campaigns & Email → Campaigns at /admin/campaigns, create or open the draft, set the Audience location, check the recipient preview, then use Send Campaign and confirm. Nothing has been sent.
